title: Bayernallee, Berlin
description:
Cosy large 1-room apartment (45 sqm) with balcony in a quiet and green avenue area.
The 46 m2 apartment  is suitable for one tenant, located in the front building ground floor (raised ground floor / 6 steps) and has a large living & bedroom (27 m2), kitchen, bathroom, balcony, hallway, separate pergola, cellar and closed bicycle room. In spring and summer the balcony with seating area and view into the green invites you to stay. 
The completely and comfortably furnished apartment is freshly renovated and equipped with telephone, Internet/WLAN (DSL 100), SAT-TV/DVD, CD/Radio/MP3, ceran stove/oven/microwave, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, refrigerator, double bed, Sitting area, wardrobe & closet, bed linen / towels, hygiene articles, washing machine, desk / utensils, shower, hair dryer, scales, iron / ironing board, clothes horse, coffee maker / kettle / toaster and books. 
Regular cleaning at a charge can also be arranged on request. This is a non-smoking apartment, but smoking on the covered balcony or pergola is possible without any problems.
The landlord is personally available for you, welcomes you warmly at the handing over of the keys and is at your disposal during your stay for further questions and tips around Berlin.
The apartment is located in Charlottenburg in the beautiful green district Westend in a traffic-calmed zone. A lot of shops and restaurants are within walking distance (300m) in the shopping street "Reichsstraße". With the underground station "Theodor-Heuss-Platz", the S-Bahn station "Messe-Nord", the bus lines 104 and X34 and a taxi stand nearby, the apartment is optimally connected to the public transport network and the city, as well as the Grunewald and other local recreation areas easily accessible. With the Berlin Exhibition Grounds, a theatre, the Olympic Stadium and the Waldbühne, which are also within walking distance, there is a large leisure and event programme in the immediate vicinity of the Reichstraße. Sports activities are also available (fitness studio, biking/running in the countryside, swimming at the nearby lakes or in the Olympic public swimming-pool).

- Staubsauger + Putzutensilien inklusive
- zum Apartment gehört ein großer Keller

Lage:

Die Wohnung ist im schönen + vornehmen charlottenburger Viertel Westend gelegen, die durch eine Vielzahl von liebevoll restaurierten Altbau - Villen und Mehrfamilienhäusern geprägt ist. Mehr als 5 gute Frühstücks- Cafes und Restaurants in weniger als 3 min. Fussweg zu erreichen.

Beste Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Reichsstrasse, ein EDEKA Supermarkt befindet sich direkt im selben Haus.
	

Trotz absolut zentraler + verkehrsgünstiger Lage befindet sich die Wohnung in einer ruhigen Seitenstrasse, die ihren Aufenthalt zur Erholung macht. Es lohnt sich einen Spaziergang zum nahegelegenen Schloss-Charlottenburg, dem Teufelsberg und dem Grunewald zu unternehmen. Und mit der U-Bahn (U2) gelangen Sie in 7 Minuten zum Kurfürstendamm und Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtnis Kirche. Erleben Sie diese aufregende vielseitige und sich ständig selbst neu erfindende Stadt hautnah. Seien sie mein Gast und wohnen in einem neu renovierten+vollmöblierten City-Apartment in zentraler, ruhiger und verkehrsgünstiger Lage.Super Verkehrsanbindung mit Bahn, Autobahn + Bus. Berlin erwartet Sie.

title: Popitzweg, Berlin
description:
Questo appartamento è per studenti universitari. 
Per le attuali leggi che regolano gli affitti a Berlino, questo appartamento può essere affittato per minimo 3 mesi. 
L'appartamento si trova nel quartiere di Siemenstadt, a pochi metri dalla fermata della metropolitana U7. 
Il monolocale è dotato di un bagno con vasca, piccolo ingresso con armadio, zona soggiorno/notte e angolo cottura con lavatrice. Un balcone completa il tutto. Non c'è la linea internet.
L'appartamento è al 6. piano di un palazzo con ascensore. 
Nell'appartamento è vietato fumare. 

Intorno al palazzo ci sono supermercati, banche, un ufficio postale, diversi ristoranti, una fermata della metropolitana U7. 
A 15 minuti a piedi c'è il parco di Jungfernheide, con un piccolo lago che in estate è balneabile.

title: Suarezstraße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished 3-room apartment on two levels located in an elegant building in the respectful area of Charlottenburg

The contempory modern living space has been designed and custom crafted by an italian architect and boasts a few details that give an innovative flair: imported floor tiles, wooden/iron stairs, design spotlights, an archway passage, a thick glass window in the bedroom, recurring grey details, and much more .

The very spacious and modern kitchen/living room is equipped with everything is needed for relaxing, cooking and eating: large sofa, glass table, american coffee machine, toaster, kettle, dishwasher, oven, fridge with refrigerator, cutlery, pots and pans and so on. The bathroom offers two useful cabinets, a modern shower at ground level, a top-loader washing machine. In the bedroom you find a double wardrobe (IKEA Pax), a comfortable double bed and a bed side table. The lower ground is a special quiet room where you can work and relax: there's a 5-door wardrobe, double bed with bed side table, large desk and a comfortable chair. Although located under ground, daylight comes in from 2 windows.

The neighbourhood is quiet and respectful, with many green areas, especially the elegant park with the lake LIETZEN SEE. Just around the corner you can find cafés, local shops and restaurants, as well as supermarkets at walking distance (EDEKA and LIDL).

The address Suarezstr. 44 is easily reachable by car via the city-highway and is well-served by public transportation. The closest station "Berlin Charlottenburg" offers both regional connections and local trains with the historic elevated central line leading to Zoologischer Garten, Hauptbahnhof, Alexander Platz, etc. In the nearby main street "Neue Kantstr." there are bus stops for the lines M. 
The internet connection with provider Vodafone is fast, reliable, flatrate and wireless.

The registration to the authorities is possible (Anmeldung). 
All costs are included in the monthly price, such as heating, water, electricity, internet, waste disposal, etc.

title: Witzlebenstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to your new home!

Our newly renovated 95 sqm flat on the top floor of an apartment building offers the perfect setting for cosy shared living. Thanks to the refurbishment, the entire flat shines in new splendour and impresses with modern comfort.

The centrepiece of the flat is the spacious and fully equipped communal kitchen. There is plenty of space here for cooking, eating and socialising together. The modern fitted kitchen has all the necessary appliances such as a hob, oven, fridge, dishwasher and plenty of storage space for all flatmates. This is where the best flat-share evenings are made!

The rooms themselves vary in size, so there is something to suit everyone. They can be rented furnished or unfurnished as required. The rooms are bright and friendly and offer enough space for privacy and personalisation. Due to the attic location, some rooms have a special charm with sloping ceilings and in some cases even a beautiful view.

In addition to the kitchen, there is a shared bathroom, which has also been modernised and is equipped with a shower or bathtub.

The entire flat has been designed with great attention to detail and offers a pleasant atmosphere. The bright rooms and modern furnishings create a feel-good ambience.

This property combines stylish living with a functional room layout and an urban lifestyle - a real highlight for anyone looking for something special.


AREA

We are located in the heart of Charlottenburg, right next to the picturesque Lietzensee Park. This unique combination of urban living and natural recreation is what makes living here so attractive.

The park itself is just a few steps from our front door and offers a welcome green oasis in the centre of the city. Here you can relax after work or at the weekend, go for a walk, jog, have a picnic or simply enjoy the peace and quiet by the water. The Lietzensee with its idyllic surroundings invites you to linger and offers a beautiful backdrop.

Despite the quiet location right next to the park, we are very well connected and benefit from Charlottenburg's excellent infrastructure. You will find everything you need for your daily needs in the immediate vicinity: Supermarkets, bakeries, pharmacies, doctors, banks and much more. The famous Kurfürstendamm shopping street with its numerous shops, boutiques and restaurants is also within easy reach.

Charlottenburg itself also offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. In addition to the Lietzensee Park, numerous cafés, restaurants and bars invite you to linger. Cultural institutions such as Charlottenburg Palace, the Deutsche Oper opera house and various theatres are also within easy reach.

And the best thing is: although we live so centrally and well connected, our flat is located in a quiet side street, so you won't be affected by any direct street noise. So here you can enjoy the benefits of urban life while living in a quiet and relaxed environment.

Mit einer großzügigen Fläche von 103 Quadratmetern, verteilt auf eine Etage im ersten Stock eines 5-stöckigen Gebäudes, bietet sie ausreichend Platz für ein harmonisches Familienleben.  Die Wohnung verfügt über ein modernes Badezimmer, das sowohl funktional als auch stilvoll ist. Balkon mit 16m2 und Terrasse mit 80 m2 gibt es und sie können die umliegende grüne Umgebung und die kurzen Wege zu Parks nutzen, um sich im Freien zu entspannen. Der Aufzug im Gebäude sorgt für zusätzlichen Komfort, besonders beim Tragen von Einkäufen oder Kinderwagen.   Die Lage dieser Wohnung ist besonders attraktiv für Familien. In der Nähe befinden sich mehrere Einrichtungen, die den Alltag erleichtern. Der nächste Kindergarten, die Kita ist nur 100 Meter entfernt und viele weitere, während die Grundschule in nur 400 Metern zu erreichen ist – optimal für die Bildung Ihres Kindes. Darüber hinaus gibt es in unmittelbarer Nähe auch eine Volkshochschule, die Ihnen und Ihrer Familie zahlreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten bietet.  Die Verkehrsanbindung ist hervorragend. In kurzer Gehdistanz finden Sie eine U-Bahnstation und den Bahnhof Spandau der Sie schnell in die Innenstadt von Berlin bringt. Damit sind Sie sowohl für kurze Einkäufe als auch für Ausflüge ins Stadtzentrum bestens vernetzt. Für Ihren täglichen Bedarf ist ein Lidl-Supermarkt nur 210 Meter entfernt, sodass Sie Besorgungen bequem zu Fuß erledigen können. Ebenso finden Sie in der Umgebung eine Vielzahl von Restaurants und Cafés, ideal für gesellige Abende mit der Familie oder Freunden.  Zusammenfassend lässt sich sagen, dass diese Wohnung in der Parkstraße eine perfekte Kombination aus Raum, Komfort und einer hervorragenden Lage bietet. Sie ist eine ideale Wahl für Familien, die Wert auf eine gute Anbindung und eine kinderfreundliche Umgebung legen. Nutzen Sie die Gelegenheit und entdecken Sie dieses wunderbare Zuhause für sich und Ihre Liebsten!

* Small home office
* Two bathrooms (one on each floor)

The apartment accommodates up to 5 people:

The neighborhood is quiet, friendly, and family-oriented. Children are especially welcome and will enjoy the toys available in one of the rooms.

title: Herscheider Weg, Berlin
description:
Charming Furnished House with Garden, Fireplace & Garage in Berlin-Tegel

This spacious and fully furnished detached house is located in a quiet and green residential area of Berlin-Tegel and offers a comfortable home for medium- or long-term stays.

The property is particularly suitable for families, couples, expats, professionals relocating to Berlin, people on temporary work assignments and remote workers looking for more space and privacy than a typical city apartment. Dog owners will also appreciate the nearby forest and dog exercise area.

The house extends over two floors plus a full basement and offers plenty of living and storage space.

It features three bedrooms, a spacious living room with fireplace and dining area, a separate home office and a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher. The dining area is connected to the kitchen by a practical serving cabinet/pass-through.

There is a bathroom with bathtub and shower as well as an additional guest WC.

The beautifully maintained private garden with terrace and several seating areas is perfect for relaxing, outdoor dining or spending time with family and friends. Garden furniture is provided, and a private garage is included.

The full basement offers extensive storage space as well as an additional finished room that can be used flexibly as a guest room, workspace, hobby room or, upon request, an additional bedroom. A washing machine and dryer are also available.

The house is rented fully furnished and is ready to move into. If preferred, some of the existing furniture can be exchanged or stored in the basement, allowing the setup to be adapted to the tenant’s needs.

The location offers an attractive combination of nature and easy access to Berlin. Tegeler See and Flughafensee are within walking distance and provide excellent opportunities for walking, jogging, swimming and relaxing by the water. The nearby forest and dog exercise area can also be reached easily on foot.

At the same time, Berlin-Tegel is well connected to central Berlin by public transport and by car, making the property a good choice for tenants who want to enjoy the city while living in a peaceful and green environment.
